limits.counting: CORE/Worker must enforce BEFORE postMessage. Count all serialized properties including identity, metadata, escaped JSON, each row and cursor. Structured-clone transport allocations/transfer bytes require conservative independent Worker resource accounting; UI rechecks after receive.

response.cursor: nonempty opaque string when incomplete, null only for complete page
response.stableOrder: total deterministic stable sort + unique logical identity tie breaker
response.rowProvenance: source-derived Core index, not client asserted graph
response.missingPointers: explicit error or typed omission reason; never infer end-of-domain from pointer watch subset

cursorProvenance.authority: only trusted same Worker/CORE; never Svelte or arbitrary caller
options: opaque random unguessable handle into Worker-private state
authenticated token verified with Worker-private secret
boundClaims: save schema and explicitly separately verified build provenance
cursorProvenance.lifetime: per local File SaveSession, invalidate on switch/close/reopen/revision/index invalidation; bounded number of outstanding handles and retention
cursorProvenance.replay: single-use continuation, atomic consume before a new page is dispatched, including concurrent query attempts
cursorProvenance.tamperOrForeignCursor: reject, no fallback to first page, never treat as authorization
cursorProvenance.uiCursorHandling: opaque byte-for-byte echo only; UI sequence fences are defense in depth, not provenance

concurrency.staleRequestCancellation: Core/Worker invalidates and discards pending pages on generation/revision change; no stale postMessage side-effects
concurrency.sessionSwitch: old source File, buffer, Row caches and cursor tickets isolated from next file
concurrency.undoRedo: only Core increases revision and invalidates affected indexes and all stale projections
concurrency.fullDomainCompletion: must derive complete/nextCursor from verified Core index enumeration, no inferred total from 512 watched pointers

trust.fileSource: browser File transferable locally, original immutable in trusted Worker
trust.externalSwitchBID: separately supplied evidence, never inferred from schema
